text: The classification of closed surfaces says every compact connected surface without boundary is homeomorphic to:
choices: a sphere or a real projective plane
a connected sum of tori (orientable) or connected sum of projective planes (non-orientable)
explanation: Classification: every compact surface is homeomorphic to S² (g=0), a connected sum Σ_g = T²#…#T² (g tori), or ℝP²#…#ℝP² (n projective planes). The Euler characteristic distinguishes them.
